items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps your skin feeling clean and comfortable without added strong ingredients.
A lightweight niacinamide gel moisturizer helps balance shine and leaves skin looking smoother.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection and helps keep skin tone looking even.

response.routine_note: I left out the 15% lactic acid serum because it is a high-strength exfoliating product, so please check with your doctor or midwife before using it while pregnant. Use the cleanser morning and night, the gel after cleansing, and the SPF every morning as the last step.
